Emily —

Thanks for the details and for sharing the audit note. We can absolutely keep your sandbox environment live; Sales Ops (Priyom) will need a quick sign-off from Finance for a temporary credit.

Two options we can do immediately:
- Provision a 7-day sandbox extension with a capped token limit (we can set 200k tokens to be safe).
- Or issue a small credit note equivalent to ~200k tokens and keep the environment running under your current seat config.

Which would you prefer? If you approve the credit route, please confirm the email for invoicing and I’ll start the internal approval flow. If you prefer the environment toggle, we can enable it today and document the expiry.

Looping Priyom and David so they see the scope — Priyom, can you advise on how we should route the temporary credit? David, any objections to a 7-day capped extension while Procurement completes their audit?

Thanks,
Kim
